description: Ping quality over one hour of monitor data (docs/DIAGNOSTICS.md #5). Rows are per-minute aggregates: ts (start of the minute, seconds since 1970; optional), target, sent, lost, optional jitter (ms). Optional 'changes' are times of network changes: rows of the minute of each change and of the next minute are left out (by ts), and a detail line counts them. Targets starting with tcp_ or http_ are TCP/HTTP probes; 'router' is the gateway; anything else is an Internet ping target. Thresholds: >= 60 samples per ping target, >= 20 per probe.
